title: Several tables: entity targets from event tables
request: Let DCLab answer questions asked about an entity at a moment, from several related tables: will this customer stop ordering in the 30 days after a date, from customers, orders and tickets.
spec: Related tables with keys; the target and features built per entity as of a cutoff time (counts, recencies, sums and trends over windows before the cutoff), with the cutoff per row recorded; checks for events after the cutoff and for one-to-many joins that duplicate rows. Done when the replica (customers, orders, support tickets; churn in the 30 days after a cutoff) is solved with no event after a row's cutoff used (tested), and a duplicating join is refused with the numbers.
plan: Make one training row per (entity, cutoff); everything about a row from events strictly before its cutoff, its target from the horizon after it.
Check every join for repeated rows before it happens, and refuse with the numbers.
Find entity columns written at the export, not at any cutoff.
Train on earlier cutoffs whose horizon ends before the latest, score once on the latest against recency alone.
Review, fix, and show each test fails on the fault it guards.

decisions.decision: Features stop strictly before the cutoff; the target window is [cutoff, cutoff + horizon).
decisions.why: With features before and the target after, an order on the cutoff day fell into neither, and every such order was lost.

decisions.decision: A training row is used only when its target's horizon ends by the holdout's cutoff, and the last event the training targets read is recorded and checked.
decisions.why: A row 15 days before the last cutoff reads 15 days of the holdout's own window as its target; checking the planned horizon instead of what was read let a doubled horizon pass.

decisions.decision: Entity numbers are compared with whole-log totals and last event times over the entities that have both.
decisions.why: A total exported with gaps made the correlation NaN and silently passed; a date stored as a number was never checked.

decisions.decision: A label table joins only before its label's time, or is refused when an entity has several cutoffs.
decisions.why: A June row of a customer whose churn was decided in March reads behaviour after the outcome.

change: dclab_core/entities.py (check_join, snapshot_rows, window_features, window_target, label_join, entity_check, build, evaluate), dclab_core/replicas/shop_customers.py, dclab_rnd/kinds/entity_tables.py, tests/test_core_entities.py, dclab_core/CHANGELOG.md, dclab_rnd/kinds/capability.json.

findings.scenario: lifetime_orders exported with gaps stayed a feature; last_order_date as epoch seconds raised the holdout ROC-AUC from 0.906 to 0.947.
findings.cause: A NaN correlation compared as False, and numeric dates were never checked.
findings.fix: Pairwise correlation with whole-log totals and last event times, absolute.
findings.impact: A snapshot taken at the end would have been scored as a forecast.

findings.defect: The guard that training targets end by the holdout's cutoff could not fail.
findings.scenario: Cutoffs 30 days apart with a 30-day horizon: removing the filter, or reading twice the horizon, passed every test and check.
findings.cause: The replica's spacing matched the horizon, and the check read the planned horizon, not what was read.
findings.fix: The target records its last read; a cutoff 15 days before the last is in the replica; the check reads the recorded time.

findings.defect: An event exactly at the cutoff fell into neither window.
findings.scenario: A customer who ordered on the cutoff day was counted as churned.
findings.cause: Features read before the cutoff and the target after it.

findings.defect: Missing keys were miscounted, so a repeating join passed.
findings.scenario: left a, None, b and right a, None, None: reported 3 to 3, the join gave 4.
findings.cause: value_counts drops missing keys; a join matches them.

findings.scenario: Rows for a at January and June with a label decided in March both got the label.
findings.fix: Only rows before the label's time, or a refusal when an entity has several cutoffs and the label has no time.

findings.defect: The kind took over other kinds' briefs.
findings.scenario: 'Forecast daily sales from the orders table' was detected as several tables instead of forecasting; 'Recommend products per customer from their orders' instead of ranking.
findings.fix: Several tables or a cutoff must be said.

findings.defect: The leak counter missed an event at the cutoff itself.
findings.scenario: With features reading up to and including the cutoff the counter stayed 0.
findings.cause: It counted reads after the cutoff only.
findings.fix: Reads at or after the cutoff count.

findings.scenario: recent + prior instead of recent - prior passed.
findings.fix: A hand case with events in both 30-day bands.

outcome: Built as a library and accepted on the replica (6 decisions); refused by the engine and partial in the matrix until a project can hold several tables.
lessons: Check what was read, not what was planned to be read.
A replica whose numbers line up hides the boundary a test was written for: put a case on the boundary.
A missing value in a correlation is a silent pass; compare over the rows that have both.
Feature and target windows must meet exactly at the cutoff, with nothing lost between them.
risks: Events after a row's cutoff in its features.
Training targets read in the holdout's window.
Columns of an export-day snapshot used as if known at a cutoff.
